svg.aria-label: Deployed AWS architecture: EventBridge Scheduler invokes a Run-Cycle Lambda that calls Bedrock and commits six arms atomically to DynamoDB, emits a cycle-completed event to an Analysis Lambda, while CloudFront serves a private S3 frontend and an API Gateway read path backed by a read-only Lambda, and the dataset export lands in a private S3 bucket served through the same distribution.

svg.text: One bounded cycle at a time. Analysis is never on the path that writes the experiment, and the read route table registers no write verb.

svg.text: Every bucket is private. Nothing is public except CloudFront. Everything deploys inert: execution off, schedule off.
